candidate.title: Musk says Trump responsible for any curbs on Ukraine's Starshield
candidate.description:
The developments come as tensions between Kyiv and Washington escalate over a supposed "energy ceasefire," between Ukraine and Russia announced by U.S. President Donald Trump.

Ukraine has welcomed a deal subject to Moscow honoring its commitment, while Russian authorities said talks were ongoing, without confirming whether they had reached an agreement. claims.claim: Elon Musk stated that Donald Trump and the U.S. government/military are ultimately responsible for any curbs or speed limits placed on Ukraine's Starshield systems.
claims.reason: Directly confirmed by multiple independent reporting outlets quoting Musk's public statement that Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the U.S. government, with limits determined by the military and ultimately POTUS.
